newsitem.title: USA: Oklahoma commissions authorize bond adviser search.
newsitem.headline: Oklahoma commissions authorize bond adviser search.

text.p: The search is on for a new state bond adviser in Oklahoma.
The state's Executive and Legislative Bond Oversight Commissions authorized the search during their joint Thursday morning meeting, according to current Bond Advisor James Joseph.

"They've authorized us to work up an advertisement, and circulate that," he said. "They've created a search committee. It will be nationally advertised and then they will work out some kind of schedule for responses."
Joseph, who has held the post since 1991, is leaving to become a partner at Government Finance Group, an Arlington, Va., financial advisory firm.

The Commissions also authorized Joseph to serve part time beginning in April and continuing either until June 30, the end of the state's 96-97 fiscal year, or until his successor takes over, should that occur first.
